name: agent-notices
description: Hooks that tell an agent about fragile shell commands, branch switches that did not happen, environment variables missing from .env.example, a temporary directory running short, and risky code patterns, format each edited file with the project's own formatter, and log skill and MCP calls when turned on, in Claude Code and Codex, without ever stopping a call

interface.shortDescription: Notices for the agent that never stop a call
interface.longDescription: Hooks that run after the agent's shell commands and edits and add a short notice the agent reads, without ever stopping a call. They point out a pipe into grep -q under pipefail, a nohup command sent to the background, a branch switch that did not happen or a commit on a branch the session did not switch to, an environment variable that .env.example does not list, a temporary directory running short, and code that one of the patterns of Anthropic's security-guidance plugin matches. After an edit, the project's own Biome, Prettier, Ruff, Black, gofmt, or rustfmt formats the file, and nothing is installed. Logs of skill and MCP calls, with names and times but no arguments, are off until you turn them on. Each hook turns off with its own environment variable. It needs Python 3.
